strings.zh: 杰尼龟『Jieni！Jieni！

strings.zh: 你们就是火箭队的人吧,{NEWLINE}来这里是想做什么坏事吗？{CLEAR}现在跟我回去接受调查！

strings.zh: 落雷兽『Eeee——lec！
strings.en: Electrike: Eeee-lec!

strings.zh: 上吧,落雷兽,{NEWLINE}赶走这些碍事的家伙。

strings.zh: 哈哈哈,知道厉害了吧！
strings.en: Ha ha ha! Now you know who you’re{NEWLINE}dealing with!

strings.zh: 前辈真厉害！{SCROLL}话说这只杰尼龟自己送上门来了,{NEWLINE}不如我们也把它抓走吧？
strings.en: Wow, Boss, you’re amazing!{SCROLL}Say, this Squirtle walked right into our{NEWLINE}hands. Why don’t we take it too?

strings.zh: 好主意,落雷兽攻击杰尼龟！
strings.en: Good idea. Electrike, attack Squirtle!

strings.zh: 情况危急,是否上前帮助杰尼龟？
strings.en: Things look bad. Step in and help{NEWLINE}Squirtle?

strings.zh: 杰尼龟支撑不住了……
strings.en: Squirtle can’t hold out much longer...

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,这只杰尼龟也是我们的了！{SCROLL}回来吧落雷兽。
strings.en: Heh heh, this Squirtle is ours too!{SCROLL}Come back, Electrike.

strings.zh: 这次抓到了珍惜的杰尼龟,{NEWLINE}回去一定能拿不少奖励！
strings.en: We caught a rare Squirtle this time!{SCROLL}We’re sure to get a big reward back at{NEWLINE}base!

strings.zh: 走吧,把这几只精灵带回基地{NEWLINE}找雅典娜大人领赏去！
strings.en: Let’s go. We’ll take these Pokémon back{NEWLINE}to base and collect our reward from{CLEAR}Master Ariana!

strings.zh: 是！前辈！
strings.en: Yes, Boss!

strings.zh: 唉……我真是太没用了……
strings.en: Sigh... I’m so useless...
{VAR:0103:0}: Stop right there!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你们这些坏人{NEWLINE}抓了精灵就只会去做坏事！{CLEAR}今天你们休想再多抓一只精灵！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: All you crooks ever do with{NEWLINE}the Pokémon you catch is evil!{SCROLL}You’re not catching one more Pokémon{NEWLINE}today!

strings.zh: 哪来的臭小鬼,{NEWLINE}真是不知天高地厚,{CLEAR}居然敢管我们火箭队的闲事！
strings.en: Where’d this brat come from? You don’t{NEWLINE}know your place, butting into Team{CLEAR}Rocket’s business!

strings.zh: 前辈,要不要教训教训他！
strings.en: Boss, should we teach this kid a lesson?

strings.zh: 咳咳,虽说只是个小鬼,{NEWLINE}但是看起来很厉害的样子,{CLEAR}咱们一起上吧！

strings.zh: 是！前辈！
strings.en: Yes, Boss!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『吓唬谁呢！快点把你们{NEWLINE}刚才抓的那几个精灵也都放了！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Who are you trying to scare?{SCROLL}Let go of all the Pokémon you just{NEWLINE}caught!

strings.en: Boss, we can’t beat this kid! What do we{NEWLINE}do now?

strings.zh: 还能怎么办,快跑啊！
strings.en: What else? Run for it!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好了,已经没事了,{NEWLINE}你们快回去吧。{CLEAR}以后不要再被坏人抓住了。{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}『当然,{NEWLINE}也不要再对路人恶作剧了,{CLEAR}这样会给人添很多麻烦的。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: There, you’re safe now. Hurry{NEWLINE}on home, all of you. Don’t get caught by{CLEAR}bad guys again.{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}: And of course, no more pranks{NEWLINE}on people passing by. It causes them a{CLEAR}lot of trouble.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『嗯嗯,已经没事了,{NEWLINE}你们快回去吧。{CLEAR}以后不要再被坏人抓住了。{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}『当然,{NEWLINE}以后不准再对路人恶作剧啦,{CLEAR}知道了吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Yep, you’re safe now. Hurry{NEWLINE}on home, all of you. Don’t get caught by{CLEAR}bad guys again.{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}: And no more pranks on people{NEWLINE}passing by. Got it?

strings.zh: 谢谢你能帮我赶走火箭队。{SCROLL}这世上如果多一点{NEWLINE}像你一样的训练家就好了。
strings.en: Thank you for helping me drive off Team{NEWLINE}Rocket.{SCROLL}If only there were more Trainers like{NEWLINE}you in this world.

strings.zh: 杰尼龟好像很喜欢你,{NEWLINE}要接受杰尼龟成为同伴吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Squirtle seems to really like you. Will{NEWLINE}you take Squirtle as a partner?{SCROLL}

strings.en: Squirtle joined {VAR:0103:0}’s team!

strings.zh: 你怎么到这里来了？{NEWLINE}难道说又有火箭队出现了？
strings.en: What are you doing here? Don’t tell me{NEWLINE}Team Rocket has shown up again?

strings.zh: 杰尼龟『Jieni,Jieni,{NEWLINE}Jieni Jieni Jieni,{CLEAR}Jieni Jieni Jie！
strings.en: Squirtle: Jieni, jieni, jieni jieni jieni,{NEWLINE}jieni jieni jie!

strings.zh: 虽然我听不懂你的龟语,{NEWLINE}但我觉得你应该是在说,{CLEAR}你要出去旅行了,{CLEAR}所以请我帮忙照顾你的朋友？
strings.en: I can’t understand your turtle talk,{NEWLINE}but I think you’re saying...{SCROLL}You’re heading off on a journey, so you{NEWLINE}want me to look after your friends?

strings.zh: 没问题！你就放心地去吧,{NEWLINE}我会把你的朋友锻炼成出色的警察的！
strings.en: No problem!{SCROLL}Go on, don’t worry. I’ll train your{NEWLINE}friends into fine police officers!

strings.zh: 杰尼龟好像有东西要送给你。
strings.en: Squirtle seems to have something for{NEWLINE}you.

strings.en: I play around here a lot, and sometimes{NEWLINE}I find Berries and stuff.{SCROLL}I can sell you some if you want.{SCROLL}

strings.en: Jaboca Berry, $1500

strings.zh: 1个命中果 1500元

strings.en: Custap Berry, $1500

strings.zh: 算了,不买了
strings.en: Nothing, thanks

strings.zh: 我每天都会来这里,{NEWLINE}什么时候需要了再来找我呀。
strings.en: I come here every day. Come find me{NEWLINE}whenever you need something.

strings.zh: 谢谢您的购买！
strings.en: Thanks for buying!

strings.zh: 嘻嘻,您钱包里的钱{NEWLINE}好像不太够啊……
strings.en: Tee-hee! Looks like you don’t have{NEWLINE}quite enough money in your wallet...

strings.zh: 巴大蝴『Butter——free！
strings.en: Butterfree: Butter-free!

strings.zh: 有人说这个季节是放生巴大蝴{NEWLINE}让他们交配繁衍的季节。{SCROLL}可是这只巴大蝴是我从绿毛虫时期{NEWLINE}一点点养到现在的,{CLEAR}我好舍不得把它放生啊！{SCROLL}你说我该怎么办呢？
strings.en: They say this is the season to release{NEWLINE}Butterfree so they can find a mate and{CLEAR}have babies.{SCROLL}But I raised this Butterfree myself, all{NEWLINE}the way from a Caterpie. I can’t bear{CLEAR}to let it go!{SCROLL}What do you think I should do?
strings.notes: Butterfree debate: #81 → choices #88 (keep) / #89 (release) / #90 (don’t ask me), then follow-up arguments #91–#108 with two-option menus; endings #109 (keep: the media push release to sell goods), #110 (take it to the Day Care), #111 (release → #112–#116), #117 (keep).

strings.zh: 沿着这条水路到10号路的南边,{NEWLINE}有一座废弃很久的发电所。{CLEAR}当时发电所的那些燃料废渣{CLEAR}未经处理就到处乱排,{CLEAR}把周围弄得寸草不生。{SCROLL}所以精灵联盟{NEWLINE}就把发电所给强制关停了。
strings.en: Follow this waterway to the south end{NEWLINE}of Route 10, and you’ll find a power{CLEAR}plant that was abandoned long ago.{SCROLL}Back then, the plant dumped its fuel{NEWLINE}waste everywhere without treating it.{CLEAR}Nothing would grow around it.{SCROLL}So the Pokémon League forced the plant{NEWLINE}to shut down.

strings.zh: 希望杰尼龟它们{NEWLINE}能通过这次的事件吸取教训,{CLEAR}不要再对路人恶作剧了。
strings.en: I hope Squirtle and its friends learned{NEWLINE}their lesson this time, and they’ll stop{CLEAR}pranking people.

strings.zh: 你和杰尼龟的旅行还顺利吗？{SCROLL}我正准备把这几个调皮的小家伙{NEWLINE}训练成合格的警卫呢！
strings.en: How’s your journey with Squirtle going?{SCROLL}I’m training these little rascals to be a{NEWLINE}proper police squad!

strings.zh: 我要努力做个合格的警卫,{NEWLINE}绝不能再让火箭队为所欲为。
strings.en: I’m going to work hard to be a proper{NEWLINE}officer. I’ll never let Team Rocket do{CLEAR}as they please again.

strings.zh: 哈哈,这几个孩子{NEWLINE}最近越来越有警卫的样子了！
strings.en: Ha ha! These kids are looking more like{NEWLINE}a real police squad every day!

strings.zh: 好吧,我自己再考虑考虑。
strings.en: All right, I’ll think it over some more{NEWLINE}myself.

strings.zh: 留下巴大蝴。
strings.en: Keep Butterfree.

strings.zh: 放生吧。
strings.en: Release it.

strings.zh: 我只是个路过的训练家,你别问我了。
strings.en: Just passing by. Don’t ask me.

strings.zh: 可是我也很想让巴大蝴{NEWLINE}拥有自己的小宝宝啊。{CLEAR}我这样为了我的快乐{CLEAR}而强行让巴大蝴留在身边的行为,{CLEAR}不会太自私了吗？
strings.en: But I really want Butterfree to have{NEWLINE}babies of its own, too.{SCROLL}Keeping Butterfree with me just to make{NEWLINE}myself happy... Isn’t that selfish?

strings.zh: 家养的口袋妖怪不生育也无所谓。
strings.en: Pets don’t need to have babies.

strings.zh: 你可以带巴大蝴去饲育屋试试。
strings.en: You could try the Day-Care.

strings.zh: 这个世界上有那么多的训练家,{NEWLINE}每个训练家都会饲养好多精灵,{CLEAR}难道他们都会放生自己的精灵{CLEAR}让他们去交配吗？
strings.en: The world’s full of Trainers, and they{NEWLINE}all raise lots of Pokémon.{SCROLL}Do they all release their Pokémon to go{NEWLINE}have babies?

strings.zh: 不放生也是训练家的权利。
strings.en: Keeping them is a Trainer’s right.
strings.notes: menu width fix (follow-up 1): was 'Not releasing is a Trainer’s right.'

strings.zh: 放生体现了你对巴大蝴的尊重。
strings.en: Releasing respects Butterfree.

strings.zh: 既然家养的精灵{NEWLINE}生不生育不重要,{CLEAR}那为什么媒体和科普杂志上{CLEAR}都在宣传让大家放生精灵,{CLEAR}好让他们回归大自然繁衍？
strings.en: If it doesn’t matter whether pet{NEWLINE}Pokémon have babies...{SCROLL}Then why are the media and science{NEWLINE}magazines all telling people to release{CLEAR}their Pokémon into the wild to breed?

strings.zh: 确实,回归自然的精灵更美丽。
strings.en: True. Wild Pokémon are prettier.

strings.zh: 他们是为了赚钱才这么说的。
strings.en: They just say that for money.
strings.notes: menu width fix (follow-up 1): was 'They only say that to make money.'

strings.zh: 可是在饲育屋里,我能给巴大蝴{NEWLINE}找到合适的交配对象吗？{CLEAR}会有人愿意用它的巴大蝴{CLEAR}或者百变怪跟我的巴大蝴交配吗？
strings.en: But could I really find Butterfree a{NEWLINE}partner at the Day-Care?{SCROLL}Would anyone let their Butterfree or{NEWLINE}Ditto breed with mine?

strings.zh: 找找看吧,应该不难的。
strings.en: Look around. Shouldn’t be hard.
strings.notes: menu width fix (follow-up 1): was 'Look around. It shouldn’t be hard.'

strings.zh: 实在找不到就算了呗。
strings.en: If you can’t find one, oh well.

strings.zh: 我知道我也有权利{NEWLINE}让巴大蝴放弃交配留在我身边,{CLEAR}可是这样的话我不就太自私了吗？
strings.en: I know I have the right to keep{NEWLINE}Butterfree and not let it breed...{SCROLL}But wouldn’t that make me way too{NEWLINE}selfish?

strings.zh: 没错,这样的行为很自私。
strings.en: Yes, that would be selfish.

strings.zh: 不会,留下巴大蝴完全无可厚非。
strings.en: No, keeping it is totally fine.

strings.zh: 我对巴大蝴的尊重{NEWLINE}就跟对人类伙伴是一样的。{SCROLL}既然我们之间{NEWLINE}有了这么深厚的感情和尊重,{CLEAR}它也非走不可吗？
strings.en: I respect Butterfree just as much as{NEWLINE}any human friend.{SCROLL}We share such a deep bond and so much{NEWLINE}respect. Does it really have to go?

strings.zh: 感情这么深的话,放不放生也不重要了。
strings.en: With a bond that deep, it’s fine.

strings.zh: 繁衍是很神圣的,别用感情绑架巴大蝴。
strings.en: Breeding’s sacred. No guilt trips

strings.zh: 哎！？你是说这些人为了{NEWLINE}卖更多的精灵和精灵球之类的物品,{CLEAR}才不断鼓动我们放生手里的精灵？{SCROLL}天啊,差点就上了他们的当！{NEWLINE}我以后再也不跟巴大蝴轻言别离了！
strings.en: Huh?! You mean these people keep{NEWLINE}pushing us to release our Pokémon just{CLEAR}so they can sell more Pokémon and Poké{CLEAR}Balls and stuff?{SCROLL}Oh my gosh, I almost fell for it!{SCROLL}I’m never letting Butterfree go that{NEWLINE}easily again!

strings.zh: 也对哦,{NEWLINE}那么多训练家都去饲育屋寄养精灵,{CLEAR}我的巴大蝴一定能在那里{CLEAR}找到心仪的男朋友！{SCROLL}明明有饲育屋这么好的地方,{NEWLINE}我却这么轻易地就跟巴大蝴说再见,{CLEAR}真是太不应该了！
strings.en: That’s true! So many Trainers leave{NEWLINE}their Pokémon at the Day-Care. My{CLEAR}Butterfree is sure to find a boyfriend{CLEAR}it likes there!{SCROLL}There’s a perfectly good place like the{NEWLINE}Day-Care, and I almost said goodbye to{CLEAR}Butterfree just like that. I should{CLEAR}know better!

strings.zh: 没错,我只顾着{NEWLINE}我跟巴大蝴之间的感情了,{CLEAR}完全没有考虑巴大蝴对繁衍的渴望。{SCROLL}我如果再固执地{NEWLINE}把巴大蝴留在身边就太自私了！
strings.en: You’re right. I was only thinking about{NEWLINE}my feelings for Butterfree. I never{CLEAR}thought about its wish to have a family.{SCROLL}If I stubbornly keep Butterfree with{NEWLINE}me, I’ll be too selfish!

strings.zh: 好了,巴大蝴,差不多该走了。{NEWLINE}飞到南方寻找属于你的幸福吧！
strings.en: OK, Butterfree, it’s about time. Fly{NEWLINE}south and find your own happiness!

strings.zh: 我会替你跟其他伙伴告别的。
strings.en: I’ll say goodbye to the rest of the{NEWLINE}team for you.

strings.zh: 巴大蝴！你要保重啊！{SCROLL}一定要生个健康的宝宝哟！
strings.en: Butterfree! Take care of yourself!{SCROLL}Have a healthy baby, OK?

strings.zh: 没错,巴大蝴只有{NEWLINE}回归到大自然中繁衍生息,{CLEAR}才能展现出它真正的美丽,{CLEAR}哪怕那时已经没有我陪在它身边了……
strings.en: That’s right. Only by going back to{NEWLINE}nature to raise a family can Butterfree{CLEAR}show its true beauty...{SCROLL}Even if I’m not by its side anymore...

strings.zh: 我当年在常磐森林{NEWLINE}抓到了一只绿毛虫,{CLEAR}那时还觉得它软软的好恶心。{SCROLL}后来它逐渐成长、吐丝变蛹,{NEWLINE}又在我遇到大针蜂攻击时{CLEAR}破茧成蝶保护了我。{SCROLL}从那以后我就跟巴大蝴一起{NEWLINE}走上了训练家的对战场,{CLEAR}成为了互相信赖的好伙伴……{SCROLL}呜呜呜,{NEWLINE}没想到竟然就这么跟它分别了,{CLEAR}好不舍啊！
strings.en: Years ago I caught a Caterpie in{NEWLINE}Viridian Forest. Back then I thought it{CLEAR}was all squishy and gross.{SCROLL}Then it grew, spun silk and became a{NEWLINE}cocoon... and when a Beedrill attacked{CLEAR}me, it burst out as a butterfly to{CLEAR}protect me.{SCROLL}After that, Butterfree and I entered{NEWLINE}the battle arena as Trainer and{CLEAR}Pokémon, and became partners who{CLEAR}trust each other...{SCROLL}Waaah... I can’t believe we’re parting{NEWLINE}just like that. I miss it already!

strings.zh: 我当年在常磐森林{NEWLINE}抓到了一只绿毛虫,{CLEAR}那时还觉得它软软的好恶心。{SCROLL}后来它逐渐成长、吐丝变蛹,{NEWLINE}又在我遇到大针蜂攻击时{CLEAR}破茧成蝶保护了我。{SCROLL}从那以后我就跟巴大蝴一起{NEWLINE}走上了训练家的对战场,{CLEAR}成为了互相信赖的好伙伴！{SCROLL}嘿嘿,一想到今后{NEWLINE}能一直跟巴大蝴在一起,{CLEAR}我就很开心呢！
strings.en: Years ago I caught a Caterpie in{NEWLINE}Viridian Forest. Back then I thought it{CLEAR}was all squishy and gross.{SCROLL}Then it grew, spun silk and became a{NEWLINE}cocoon... and when a Beedrill attacked{CLEAR}me, it burst out as a butterfly to{CLEAR}protect me.{SCROLL}After that, Butterfree and I entered{NEWLINE}the battle arena as Trainer and{CLEAR}Pokémon, and became partners who{CLEAR}trust each other!{SCROLL}Heh heh! Just thinking that I get to{NEWLINE}stay with Butterfree from now on makes{CLEAR}me so happy!

strings.zh: 唉,作为一个警察{NEWLINE}我真是太弱了……
strings.en: Sigh... For a police officer, I’m way too{NEWLINE}weak...

strings.zh: 社会安定人人有责,{NEWLINE}请你务必当一个遵纪守法的好公民。
strings.en: Keeping the peace is everyone’s duty.{NEWLINE}Please be a good, law-abiding citizen.

strings.zh: 派拉斯身上的蘑菇{NEWLINE}有很高的药用、实用价值。{CLEAR}但直接从它们身上取下蘑菇{CLEAR}会让它们感到非常疼痛。{SCROLL}所以从派拉斯身上取下蘑菇时,{NEWLINE}先用驱虫喷雾麻醉是个不错的选择。{CLEAR}可惜我身上只有药效比较强的{CLEAR}金色和银色喷雾,{CLEAR}没有适合派拉斯的普通喷雾。{SCROLL}你如果有普通驱虫喷雾的话{NEWLINE}能分我一点吗？
strings.en: The mushrooms on a Paras are very{NEWLINE}valuable, both as medicine and for{CLEAR}everyday use.{SCROLL}But pulling them straight off hurts the{NEWLINE}Paras a lot.{SCROLL}So when you harvest mushrooms from a{NEWLINE}Paras, it’s a good idea to numb it with a{CLEAR}Repel first.{SCROLL}Sadly, all I have on me are the{NEWLINE}stronger Max Repels and Super Repels.{SCROLL}No plain Repels that are right for{NEWLINE}Paras.{SCROLL}If you have a regular Repel, could you{NEWLINE}spare me one?
strings.notes: 金色和银色喷雾 read as Max Repel (黄金喷雾) and Super Repel (白银喷雾).

strings.zh: 好吧,我再想想别的办法。
strings.en: All right, I’ll think of something else.

strings.zh: 呃……你真的有驱虫喷雾吗？{NEWLINE}麻烦你再确认一下背包吧。
strings.en: Er... Do you really have a Repel? Please{NEWLINE}check your Bag again.

strings.zh: 谢谢你这么大方肯送我驱虫喷雾,{NEWLINE}我也不能白拿你的东西,{CLEAR}这个送给你吧。
strings.en: Thanks for so kindly giving me a Repel. I{NEWLINE}can’t take it for nothing, so please{CLEAR}have this.

strings.zh: 有了驱虫喷雾之后{NEWLINE}摘蘑菇就方便多了。{CLEAR}你以后如果需要蘑菇的话{CLEAR}随时可以来我这里买。
strings.en: Now that I have a Repel, picking{NEWLINE}mushrooms is much easier.{SCROLL}If you ever need mushrooms, you can{NEWLINE}come buy them from me anytime.

strings.zh: 欢迎啊,要来买蘑菇吗？
strings.en: Welcome! Here to buy some mushrooms?

strings.zh: 大蘑菇,3000元
strings.en: Big Mushroom, $3000

strings.zh: 小蘑菇,1000元
strings.en: Tiny Mushroom, $1000

strings.zh: 先不买了
strings.en: Not now

strings.zh: 需要的话随时可以来找我。
strings.en: Come find me whenever you need some.

strings.zh: 来,给你。
strings.en: Here you go.

strings.zh: 你身上的钱不够啊！
strings.en: You don’t have enough money!

strings.zh: 派拉斯『Paaaa——ra！
strings.en: Paras: Paaaa-ra!

strings.zh: 我经常在这一带玩,{NEWLINE}偶尔会捡到一些蘑菇。{CLEAR}你需要的话可以卖给你哦。{SCROLL}
strings.en: I play around here a lot, and sometimes{NEWLINE}I find mushrooms.{SCROLL}I can sell you some if you want.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我是来这里放生巴大蝴的,{NEWLINE}真到了分别的时刻{CLEAR}才发现自己是那么舍不得它。
strings.en: I came here to release my Butterfree.{NEWLINE}But now that it’s time to say goodbye, I{CLEAR}realize how much I want to keep it.

strings.zh: 希望巴大蝴能在未知的远方{NEWLINE}找到属于自己的幸福生活。
strings.en: I hope Butterfree finds a happy life of{NEWLINE}its own, somewhere far away.

strings.zh: 虽说这里是放生巴大蝴的地方,{NEWLINE}但是好像没有人真的在放生啊。{CLEAR}既然这样,干脆我也不放生了,{CLEAR}何苦要强迫自己和巴大蝴分别呢。
strings.en: This is supposed to be where people{NEWLINE}release their Butterfree, but it{CLEAR}doesn’t look like anyone actually does.{SCROLL}In that case, I won’t release mine{NEWLINE}either. Why force myself to say goodbye{CLEAR}to Butterfree?

strings.zh: 你想向我挑战吗？{NEWLINE}但是以你现在的徽章数量{CLEAR}还不是我的对手,{CLEAR}等你多收集几枚徽章之后{CLEAR}再来找我吧。
strings.en: You want to challenge me? With the{NEWLINE}Badges you have now, you’re no match{CLEAR}for me.{SCROLL}Come find me after you’ve collected a{NEWLINE}few more.

strings.zh: 终于等来了一位厉害的训练家,{NEWLINE}你愿意跟我来一场精灵对战吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: At last, a strong Trainer! Will you have{NEWLINE}a Pokémon battle with me?{SCROLL}

strings.en: Single or Double Battle?{SCROLL}

strings.en: You don’t have enough Pokémon with you{NEWLINE}for a Double Battle.
